Mode boundary (ADR-002): crop_alert_raised + focus_confirmed switch plot to Precision Mode; closed or closed_without_fumigation return to Area Mode.<br/>2. Human authorization invariant: only a Federation agronomist (MFA <= 10 min) authorizes an order; authorizer != pilot; no trigger ever authorizes.<br/>3. Five mandatory non-substitutable services: delimitation, confirmation, fumigation, verification, estimation.<br/>4. Closure & quarantine: order closes only after verification result; ungranted objects move to S3 quarantine/; person_present moves to restricted/.<br/>5. Dashed lines = timeout, rejection, revocation, cancellation, or direct/late recovery path; solid lines = normal progression." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="113" width="1902" x="49" y="993" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>

div.div:
1. Mode boundary (ADR-002): crop_alert_raised + focus_confirmed switch plot to Precision Mode; closed or closed_without_fumigation return to Area Mode.
2. Human authorization invariant: only a Federation agronomist (MFA <= 10 min) authorizes an order; authorizer != pilot; no trigger ever authorizes.
3. Five mandatory non-substitutable services: delimitation, confirmation, fumigation, verification, estimation.
4. Closure & quarantine: order closes only after verification result; ungranted objects move to S3 quarantine/; person_present moves to restricted/.
5. Dashed lines = timeout, rejection, revocation, cancellation, or direct/late recovery path; solid lines = normal progression.
